blockingFindings.title: Per-Run MutationDeclaration is not checkpoint-composable across a multi-Action Change
blockingFindings.requiredRevision: Define a pre-mutation, non-retroactive and recoverable declaration lifecycle, and define checkpoint scope as the deterministic accumulated coverage of all relevant declarations since the previous checkpoint (or an equivalent bounded pre-authorized scope).
